payload.summary: Local and http-served builds emit https:// absolute URLs that cannot connect
payload.detail: metadata-base.ts:49 defaults the protocol to https when no x-forwarded-proto header is present, so a local build emits https://localhost:<port>/... links failing with ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR. This was the ONLY distinct console error across 509 captures of 78 routes. Production behind Railway sets the header and is unaffected; this is a local-development and reverse-proxy-without-the-header concern.
